mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, u.login_id AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.performance_detail, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ref, a.created_at, a.updated_at
FROM education_achievements a JOIN course_operation_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'FR-030' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N'
FOR UPDATE OF a

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY m.effective_start_date DESC, m.mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_management_items m WHERE m.management_item_code = #{code} AND m.active_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, achievement_detail = #{performanceDetails}, attachment_ref = #{attachmentRef}, updated_by = #{teacherUserId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, request_id = #{requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND achievement_type = 'FR-030' AND teacher_user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
UPDATE course_operation_achievement_details SET performance_detail = #{performanceDetails}, updated_by = #{teacherUserId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId}
